verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents creating a custom avatar of a real person: a digital twin from a 15-second video, a Photo Avatar from a still image, and a Custom Video Avatar included in plans. Nothing in the pack describes the consent or identity-verification flow that is the distinguishing part of this story. missing for 10: documented consent capture flow, verification of the subject's identity/authorization, independent or hands-on corroboration of the avatar-creation process.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow

citations.quote: Create a realistic AI digital twin from a 15 sec video with consistent identity, natural motion, and voice in 175+ languages.
A Photo Avatar is created from a single still image of a person.
One Custom Video Avatar, plus 500+ ready-made presenters
